items.textToSpeech: For females aged 15+, excluding those pregnant or lactating, the Population Reference Intake for folate is 330 micrograms of dietary folate equivalents per day. Natural food folates have a lower bioavailability than synthetic folic acid. The Population Reference Intake is equivalent to 330 micrograms of natural food folate, or 198 micrograms of folic acid from fortified food or a supplement consumed with food, or 165 micrograms as a folic acid supplement taken on an empty stomach.
The Population Reference Intake is the level of nutrient intake that will meet the requirements of 97.5% of the individuals in the population. Is there anything else I can help you with?
